messages:
Nina V: FYI — LicenseHub sent an eval invoice charging 30 developer seats though we only onboarded 5 devs. tagging procurement. @Carlos M @Gwen H

Carlos M: that's bad. paste the invoice excerpt

Nina V: SKU: LH-DEV-SEAT Unit:$25/seat Qty:30 Line:$750 Note: onboarding-bundle
We expected Qty=5.

Gwen H: procurement usually sees onboarding bundles auto-applied after trial; sometimes their onboarding script counts invited users rather than accepted seats. ask them for seat assignment export.

procurement-bot: pulling LicenseHub seat roster and billing CSV for org:redwood-trial-187765... https://s3.company/billing/licensehub/licensehub-187765.csv :gear:

Carlos M: CSV shows 28 invited users + 2 service accounts flagged as "seat=1". LicenseHub's policy charges invited+service accounts. We should ask for an exception for service accounts during trials.

Gwen H: action: open ticket LH-GL-9001 requesting corrected invoice to Qty=5, rollback for trial, and ask for a renewal discount for mis-billing. cc finance@redwood.

Nina V: noted. if they push back, require proof of seat policy in contract. keeping payment on hold until resolved.

Carlos M: creating ticket now. ETA vendor 48h. Will update here.
